packageRules.description: Keep every update review-only. Windows changes need the engine dry run and chezmoi apply on Korolev from the pull request branch before merging, as AGENTS.md requires.

Hold TypeScript 7.0 because it ships no compiler API. typescript-language-server reports no valid TypeScript installation and svelte2tsx throws on missing ScriptTarget.Latest. TypeScript 7.1 is expected to restore the API. Remove this rule when that update lands. Upstream: https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/issues/10940
